login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to continue
login.hospitalStaffDesc: Login with your Veterinarian account. Your hospital dashboard is inside.
login.dbWakingUp: Database is waking up, retrying automatically in {{countdown}}s…
login.dbWakingUpNote: This is normal on first visit. Please wait.
login.pendingNoReRegister: Your details are already with us. Please do not register again - signing up a second time will not speed up the review.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Get started in under 2 minutes
register.corporateAdminCalloutBody: As a Hospital Network Admin, you can create and manage multiple hospital branches, onboard doctors and staff, monitor performance, and manage network-wide patient care, all from your dedicated dashboard.
register.termsNote: By creating an account you agree to our Terms of Service

validation.passwordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.passwordComplexity: Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, and a number
validation.acceptTermsRequired: Please accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to continue.

register.groomerNoticeBody: Your account is active right away. After signing in, add your business details and service menu. Our team verifies every business before it appears in customer search.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.successBody: If an account exists for this email, a password reset link has been sent. The link is valid for 1 hour.
forgotPassword.spamHint: Didn't receive it? Check your spam folder.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Your new password must be at least 8 characters.
resetPassword.successBody: Your password has been updated. You can now log in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidToken: This reset link is malformed or invalid.
resetPassword.reasonExpired: This reset link has expired. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.reasonUsed: This reset link has already been used. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.reasonInvalid: This reset link is invalid or does not exist.
resetPassword.passwordWeak: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.
resetPassword.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

acceptInvite.noToken: Invalid invitation link: no token provided
acceptInvite.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
acceptInvite.successMsg: Your account has been created and linked to the hospital. You can now log in to start managing patients and appointments.
